title: Babar Naam Gandhi Ji
desc: Kencho, a 10-year-old boy, grows up as a beggar and befriends a social worker, whom he calls NGO da. In an attempt to encourage Kencho to study, NGO convinces him that Mahatma Gandhi was his father.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Bengali artists love devotional and folk songs. These songs inspire singers and audiences alike. They celebrate culture and faith, creating a shared experience.

title: Mon Mayuree
desc: Priyo, a poor orphan, secures a job through his mentor Sunil Da. Meanwhile, he falls for his boss's daughter, but a child calling him father sparks trouble.

title: Debibaran
desc: Satyapriyo fights for justice when his sister is raped. During his fight, he takes on a corrupt village official in a twisted turn of events.

title: Rajar Meye Parul
desc: A childless king marries a woodcutter's daughter to gain an heir. However, his wives kill his seven children, leaving only his daughter Parul, who grows up to be a charming young lady.

title: Ekanto Apon
desc: Sudipa falls in love with Ranobir, a goon, and soon, they both get married. However, things take a turn when Ranobir is arrested and gets imprisoned.

title: Ajker Santan
desc: Chandranath, a factory worker, dies trying to fund his daughter Rani's wedding. After his death, his biological children mistreat his family, while his adopted son Aninda shows true loyalty.
